idle: {d} stands in a loose fighting stance, breathing heavily and bouncing slightly, shifting his weight, ready to brawl.
walk: {d} walks forward to the right with a menacing swagger, fists ready, steady pace.
punch_high: {d} throws a hard right hook at head height with a big shoulder turn, then returns to his fighting stance.
punch_mid: {d} steps in and throws a heavy straight punch at stomach height, leaning forward, then returns to his fighting stance.
kick_low: {d} snaps a low kick at shin height with his right leg, then puts the foot back down in his fighting stance.
hurt: {d} flinches hard as if shoved, his head jerks back and he staggers one step backward, then recovers his balance.
death: Like a movie stuntman, {d} goes limp, collapses and falls backward flat onto the ground, and lies completely still.
npc_idle: {d} stands on the pavement waiting, shifting weight, glancing around and gesturing a little, calm, not fighting.
